industry_analysis.culture: Fashion trends vary significantly by region and culture. Modest fashion growing rapidly in Muslim-majority markets. Streetwear and athleisure are global trends. Traditional and ethnic wear maintains strong demand in specific markets.
industry_analysis.consumer: Fast fashion vs. sustainable fashion tension defining the market. Size inclusivity increasingly important. Online shopping dominant with high return rates (20-40%). Brand storytelling and values matter to younger consumers.
industry_analysis.infra: Textile labeling requirements (fiber content, care instructions). REACH compliance for chemicals used in production. OEKO-TEX and GOTS certifications valued by retailers. Manufacturing concentrated in Asia, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Cambodia.
industry_analysis.population: Gen Z and Millennials drive trend cycles. Plus-size market significantly underserved. Gender-neutral fashion emerging as a segment. Aging populations seek comfort, ease of dressing, and functionality.
industry_analysis.social: Sustainability and ethical production concerns paramount. Body positivity movement reshaping sizing. Influencer and celebrity fashion influence amplified by social media. Rental, resale, and second-hand markets growing rapidly.
industry_analysis.environment: Circular fashion and textile recycling initiatives. Water usage in cotton and dyeing processes. Microfiber pollution from synthetic fabrics. Carbon footprint transparency and Science-Based Targets expected.
industry_analysis.opportunity: Sustainable and ethical fashion brands gaining market share. Made-to-measure and mass customization technology. Emerging market middle class growth. Athleisure and performance wear continuing expansion.

compliance_summary: Textile fiber content labeling, care labeling, REACH (chemical compliance), OEKO-TEX certification, flammability testing for children's wear.
